reviewer: grammar-content agent auditing root engine and practice tools
method: 20 explicit checks across10 criteria, executed against the production engine plus static interface copy inspection. This is an internal checklist result, not an independent learner satisfaction or language-proficiency rating.

checks.name: Accent remains meaningful
checks.evidence: Executed e/è rejection and capitalisation/final-punctuation acceptance with production normaliser.

checks.name: Common apostrophe and word-order variants work
checks.evidence: Executed straight-apostrophe, time-first and common adverb-placement alternatives.

checks.name: A correction cannot rewrite the first attempt
checks.evidence: Submitted wrong la mano article then corrected it; first-try accuracy stayed zero and correction was supported.

checks.name: Hint evidence survives reload and blocks independent credit
checks.evidence: Recorded hint use, serialised/reloaded, then answered correctly with hintUsed=false; saved evidence still marked support.

checks.name: Unsubmitted grammar draft and personal work survive
checks.evidence: Round-tripped partial answer, exercise index, production draft, rubric and revealed-model state.

checks.name: Submitted diagnostic progress is resumable and immutable
checks.evidence: Paused after a wrong diagnostic answer, reloaded and attempted replacement; original record remained.

checks.name: Grammar completion waits for practice and production
checks.evidence: Attempted early completion at zero work and after exercises alone; both blocked until personal response and all self-checks.

checks.name: Production is explicitly self-assessed
checks.evidence: Inspected production UI wording and confirmed all28 tasks supply bilingual model and three self-check criteria.

checks.name: Repeated clicks and rewrites cannot farm exercise points
checks.evidence: 25 distinct retry strings earned no extra XP/minutes; first evidence retained in bounded12-attempt history.

checks.name: Completion points are awarded once
checks.evidence: Repeated completion did not add unit XP.

checks.name: Mixed diagnostic spans twelve core domains
checks.evidence: Executed readiness sampling and checked core-only,12 distinct units, past and preposition representation.

checks.name: Tense check has twelve distinct questions and no certification promise
checks.evidence: Executed12-item tense sample and inspected explicit non-certification wording and speaking/listening follow-up.

checks.name: Errors return tomorrow, not immediately as new due work
checks.evidence: Mistake scheduled one day later with no same-day due-loop.

checks.name: Blind later success moves the next review out
checks.evidence: Independent next-day recall moved review to three days later while original first-try evidence remained.

checks.name: All seven budgets have complete, persisted guided recipes
checks.evidence: Executed5/10/15/20/30/45/60-minute recipe sums and session snapshot round trips.

checks.name: Time claims are estimates and a study day can take multiple sittings
checks.evidence: Inspected itinerary estimate wording and all three programme pacing descriptions.

checks.name: Required missions are bounded and prerequisites fit taught order
checks.evidence: Verified one required transfer mission per study day and ordered prerequisites for both main courses.

checks.name: Programme gates cannot skip incomplete earlier days
checks.evidence: Executed incomplete-day and out-of-order blocks; programme switching retained completed grammar and missions.

checks.name: Recall ratings schedule future practice without repeat farming
checks.evidence: Executed correct and forgotten word ratings, tomorrow retries and zero rating XP.

checks.name: Saving, unsaving and re-saving preserves memory history
checks.evidence: Toggled favourite through a reload without losing successful recall or next review date.

repairedFindings: Natural common Italian adverb-order variants now accepted in reorder practice.
Programme summaries now match required completion gates and allow a study day to span sittings.
Each programme day now has one required transfer mission, reducing burden while related missions remain available.
Time-frequency prerequisites were adjusted to avoid requiring a preposition unit scheduled later.
Prompts ask for the needed answer shape; the UI no longer insists that every tense/transform answer be a full sentence.
limitations: This audit executed engine paths and inspected interface source. Separate browser/UI audit owns rendering, keyboard, mobile and visual evidence.
Personal production and companion quality are self-assessed; the app checks completion evidence, not free-text linguistic correctness.
Unsubmitted diagnostic text is not persisted; the interface promises saved submitted answers. Grammar exercise and production drafts do persist.
Programme switching preserves learning records but restarts the selected programme day counter; verify the final UI explains this.
Exact-match controlled exercises cover listed common variants, not every grammatically possible Italian paraphrase.
Study-minute credit and plan duration are estimates; no human learner timing study was performed.
